title: Video face detailer
description: Detail small faces in video without per-frame identity flicker: crop a stable face window, resample it with a TEMPORAL sampler, graft only its high frequencies back. Experimental - Phase 0 is a bench GO/NO-GO before any app work. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-15: the SeedVR2 node choice is settled - the BUNDLED CORE NODES win a measured bake-off against the numz pack (core resolves ~50% more detail at matched chunk size, and BlockSwap does not fix the OOM). Take comfy_extras.nodes_seedvr as the sampler. Evidence: MPI-506 brief 2f-ter.
